product_one_liner.value: Perceptyx provides an AI-powered employee experience platform for enterprises to understand employee feedback and turn insights into actions that improve engagement, performance, and wellbeing.
product_one_liner.notes: Perceptyx describes its AI-powered continuous-listening platform as helping enterprise leaders understand employee needs and turn insights into action across engagement, performance, and wellbeing. Sources: https://jobs.gem.com/perceptyx/am9icG9zdDoS5Ndr7zZRBrcWLEKNvhEb and https://www.perceptyx.com/.

pricing_page.notes: The official homepage navigation has no pricing link, and the pricing review reports that perceptyx.com has no public pricing page and that /pricing returns 404. Sources: https://www.perceptyx.com/ and https://assessmentcloud.com/perceptyx-pricing.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The homepage presents VNS Health, Amtrak, and Prudential in customer-success sections, each with results and a linked full story. Source: https://www.perceptyx.com/. | named_customers.0: VNS Health appears in a customer-success section with a turnover-reduction result and linked story. Source: https://www.perceptyx.com/. | named_customers.1: Amtrak appears in a customer-success section with retention results and a linked story. Source: https://www.perceptyx.com/. | named_customers.2: Prudential appears in a customer-success section describing reduced top-talent turnover and linking to its story. Source: https://www.perceptyx.com/.

employee_band.notes: The profile reports 345 employees as of June 5, 2026, placing Perceptyx in the 201-500 band. Source: https://content.pitchbook.com/profiles/company/261844-57.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The profile explicitly lists the headquarters city as Temecula, California. Source: https://content.pitchbook.com/profiles/company/261844-57. | hq_country: The headquarters address is explicitly listed in Temecula, California, United States. Source: https://graphiq.ai/dossier/perceptyx.

founded_year.notes: TCV's company profile explicitly states 2003, and Perceptyx's original investment announcement independently confirms that founding year. Sources: https://www.tcv.com/partnerships/perceptyx and https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2019/08/12/1900678/0/en/perceptyx-announces-strategic-investment-from-tcv.html.

eng_blog.notes: The readable blog index presents employee-experience research, HR guidance, company news, and product-related content. It does not establish the required two product-building posts authored by engineers. Source: https://www.perceptyx.com/blog/.

public_docs.notes: The public developer portal contains multiple separate guides, including Authentication, Rate Limiting, and Response Codes. Source: https://developer.perceptyx.com/.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live careers board lists two openings: Enterprise Sales Development Representative and VP, Strategic Expansion. Neither is a qualifying AI, ML, or data-science role. Source: https://jobs.gem.com/perceptyx.

model_provider.notes: The August 2026 transparency document explicitly names OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google as subprocessors for optional generative features. Source: https://go.perceptyx.com/hubfs/Legal/Data%20Protection%20and%20AI%20Transparency%20Overview%20-%20August%202026.pdf.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The official trust page claims ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II compliance and full adherence to GDPR. GDPR is a regulatory-compliance claim rather than an independent certification. Source: https://www.perceptyx.com/security-trust-center. | compliance_certs.0: The official trust page explicitly claims SOC 2 Type 2 attestation. Source: https://www.perceptyx.com/security-trust-center. | compliance_certs.1: The AI governance document expressly states that Perceptyx is ISO 27001 certified. Source: https://go.perceptyx.com/hubfs/trust-center/Perceptyx%20AI%20Model%20Governance%20%26%20Overview.docx%20(1).pdf. | compliance_certs.2: The trust page claims full adherence to GDPR; this is a compliance claim, not an independent certification. Source: https://www.perceptyx.com/security-trust-center.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The latest financing deal type is explicitly labeled Debt Refinancing, rather than an equity-series round. Source: https://content.pitchbook.com/profiles/company/261844-57. | funding_date: The latest financing date is explicitly July 1, 2024, yielding 2024-07 in the requested format. Source: https://content.pitchbook.com/profiles/company/261844-57. | funding_amount_usd: The profile identifies the latest financing as an $80 million debt refinancing dated July 1, 2024. The amount is converted directly to 80000000 USD. Source: https://content.pitchbook.com/profiles/company/261844-57.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest recorded financing is July 1, 2024, before the eighteen-month window beginning May 9, 2025. Source: https://content.pitchbook.com/profiles/company/261844-57.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: An Enterprise Sales Development Representative posting is live and linked from the company's current careers board. Sources: https://jobs.gem.com/perceptyx/am9icG9zdDoS5Ndr7zZRBrcWLEKNvhEb and https://jobs.gem.com/perceptyx.

launched_6mo.notes: Perceptyx announced the launch of Perceptyx Anywhere on September 29, 2026, within the requested six-month window. Source: https://blog.perceptyx.com/perceptyx-launches-perceptyx-anywhere.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: In a June 25, 2026 article, Mary Poppen says she joined Perceptyx as Chief Customer Officer earlier that month. This falls within the requested twelve-month window. Source: https://blog.perceptyx.com/why-i-joined-perceptyx-as-chief-customer-officer.
